name: Menu Version Control MVP
description: Foundation for the LMA Menu Version Control System

userStories.title: Database Schema Setup
userStories.description: Set up Vercel Postgres with Drizzle ORM and create initial schema
acceptanceCriteria: Drizzle ORM configured with Vercel Postgres
User, Menu, Version, Comment tables created
Migrations run successfully

userStories.title: Simple Password Authentication
userStories.description: Implement password-based auth where each user has a unique password
acceptanceCriteria: Login page at /login with single password input field
POST /api/auth/login - validates password, returns user, sets session cookie
POST /api/auth/logout - clears session cookie
GET /api/auth/me - returns current user data or 401
lib/auth.ts - session helpers using jose for JWT (encrypt/decrypt cookie)
middleware.ts - protects all routes except /login and /api/auth/*
Session cookie is HTTP-only with 30-day expiry
Invalid password returns appropriate error message
bun run build passes without errors

userStories.title: Dashboard Menu List
userStories.description: Display all menus with current status on dashboard
acceptanceCriteria: app/page.tsx shows dashboard (replaces Next.js boilerplate)
app/layout.tsx includes app shell with navigation header
GET /api/menus returns array of menus with their current version status
Menu cards display: name, category, current status, last updated date
Status badges use design colors: Draft #9CA3AF, In Review #F59E0B, Approved #10B981, Live #E07A5F
Empty state shown when no menus exist
New Menu button present (can be placeholder)
Background uses warm cream #FAF7F2, text uses deep brown #3D2E2E
bun run build passes without errors

userStories.title: PDF Upload for Versions
userStories.description: Upload PDF files to Vercel Blob when creating new versions
acceptanceCriteria: app/menus/[id]/page.tsx shows menu detail with version list
app/menus/[id]/new-version/page.tsx - upload form with PDF input, change reason, summary
POST /api/menus/[id]/versions - creates version record, uploads PDF to Vercel Blob
lib/blob.ts - helper functions for Vercel Blob uploads
New version created with status 'draft'
PDF URL stored in version record
Redirects to menu detail page after successful upload
bun run build passes without errors

userStories.title: Version Status Workflow
userStories.description: Implement status transitions: Draft → In Review → Approved → Live
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/versions/[id]/status - changes version status with role checks
lib/permissions.ts - role-based permission checks for status transitions
Version cards show current status with appropriate action buttons
Admin can: Draft→In Review, In Review→Draft (reject), In Review→Approved, Approved→Live
Approver can: In Review→Approved only
Designer/Reviewer/Contributor: view only, no status changes
When version goes Live, previous Live version auto-archived
Activity log entry created on each status change
bun run build passes without errors
